thread:
incidents-bot: 🔔 Pager: PRE-FILL GPU OOM on cluster 'infer-us-west-2'. ~100 container restarts in last 5m. Severity: P1. Paging @oncall-julia @sre-sam

oncall-julia: On it. Acknowledging pager.

sre-sam: looking at metrics now — memUtil on gpus spiked to 99% across pool-gpu-2, restart loop on node ip-10-2-45-11.

runtime-tom: logs show repeated `CUDA out of memory` during prefill for model redwood-13b-long. Large context requests (~200k tokens) coming from a single customer tenant.

support-oliver: customer-rt1 reported ~10% error rate and some 503s starting ~00:03 UTC. Ticket #INC-4123 opened.

oncall-julia: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily route redwood-13b-long traffic to cold-fallback variant; 2) enable prefill trimming + max_prefill_tokens=8192; 3) cordon the noisy node if restarts persist. I'll run steps 1-2 now.

deploy-bot: rolling config update queued: set route(redwood-13b-long).fallback=cold-13b, set PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=8192 for pool-gpu-2.

runtime-tom: quick kubectl snippets if needed:
```
# annotate route to force fallback
kubectl patch svc redwood-route-13b -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"fallback":"cold-13b"}}}}}'
# cordon node
kubectl cordon ip-10-2-45-11
```

sre-sam: running cordon now, and increasing eviction threshold to avoid immediate restarts.

oncall-julia: deploy-bot reports config applied to 60% of pods. Monitoring.

support-oliver: sending customer-rt1 an interim update: "We're investigating elevated error rates affecting long-context requests; we're applying mitigations and will follow up within 15m."

runtime-tom: observed immediate drop in prefill memory pressure after fallback started. Container restart rate down from ~20/min to ~2/min on affected nodes.

sre-sam: node ip-10-2-45-11 still has one pod getting OOM, looks like an old pinned container. Evicting it now.

oncall-julia: evict complete. pods stabilizing. Latency for fallback model is slightly higher but within SLO for most endpoints.

pm-maya: can we capture which API keys caused the long-context requests? we need to notify their account team.

support-oliver: we have request traces showing api_key=acct-zt-9 flagged repeatedly from 35.211.48.3 — sending to account-eng.

runtime-tom: root cause hypothesis: unbounded long-context prefill requests for redwood-13b-long exhausted GPU KV cache and triggered CUDA OOM, causing container restarts and cascading node instability.

sre-sam: short-term actions recorded: fallback enabled, PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS set to 8192, cordon+evict noisy node, increase batch timeouts.

oncall-julia: customer impact summary for status page: "Some customers sending very large context windows experienced request errors and elevated latency between 00:03–00:12 UTC. Mitigation applied; majority restored by 00:08 UTC. Specific tenant acct-zt-9 was rate-limited and we are contacting them."

support-oliver: posted update to ticket INC-4123 and notified AE.

pm-maya: we should schedule a postmortem and include: 1) why fallback didn't trigger earlier, 2) harder limits for long-context routes, 3) telemetry improvement for prefill mem signals.

oncall-julia: agreed. I'll handoff to postmortems and mark this incident as mitigated. Moving to cleanup and RCA.

incidents-bot: Incident P1 mitigated by oncall-julia. Time to mitigation: ~5m. Please file postmortem in #postmortems with tag `prefill-oom`.
